annotations.title: Has an approved MCP server changed? (7Maps)

description: Use this before reusing an MCP server that a person approved earlier: tells whether its tools changed since that date, and whether any change raised the risk (a tool that now deletes, pays or runs code), including silent changes made without a new server version. If the risk went up, ask the person to approve again before calling it. Which to use: watch for one server since a date; verify_lock against a lock you saved; changes_since for up to 50 servers at once. Paid per check (see list_paid_tools). Reads the map only.

approved_at.description: When the person approved this server (YYYY-MM-DD)

last_trip.description: Optional: how your previous call to a server 7Maps named went

ok.description: Did it do what you needed

surprise.description: Side effect you did not ask for

license_key.description: 7IT plan license key; else pay per call (x402)

server.description: The server URL, its official registry name, or npm:<package> / pypi:<package>
